description: When a weather report stops counting, Unix seconds UTC, or null where nothing says: a routine METAR an hour after it was observed (AIM 7-1-28, "METAR-hourly"; FMH-1 ch. 2), a SPECI when the next routine report is due, a TAF, the FB winds or an advisory at the end of the valid time its header gives (FAA-H-8083-28B 27.4.1, Table 27-2, 26.2-26.3).

observed.description: When a METAR or SPECI was observed, Unix seconds.

last_routine.description: For a SPECI, the last routine report's time, Unix seconds, where it is known.

valid_to.description: For a forecast, the end of its valid time (the FB winds' FOR USE window), Unix seconds.
